issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §7.1 aggregate() and §5 expression-parameter iteration variables: $total is scoped to aggregate evaluation; $this/$index are expression-parameter iteration variables and must not leak after function evaluation.
issues.evidence: Fresh native-vs-forced-fallback DuckDB probe: native fhirpath_json({}, "(1|2).aggregate($this+$total,0) + $index") returned NULL/empty, while forced Python fallback returned [4]. Direct Python evaluate returned [4]. Similar drift for + $total and combine($index)/combine($total), showing aggregate_macro leaves $total and $index in ctx after returning.
issues.resolution: Python expression parameters restore $this; aggregate_macro restores $total/$index after evaluation.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §8.2 Comments: single-line and multi-line comments are ignored by the language.
issues.evidence: Fresh native-vs-forced-fallback DuckDB probe: native fhirpath_json(resource, "/* lead */ id") returned ["p"] and fhirpath_is_valid=true. Forced Python fallback raised FHIRPathSyntaxError from _INVALID_EXPR_PATTERNS because it classified the leading / in a block comment as a leading operator.
issues.resolution: DuckDB fallback wrapper prechecks strip ignored comments and delimiter balance ignores strings/delimited identifiers/comments.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §8.3 Literals: string literals are strings enclosed in single ticks; fhirpath_json must serialize String values as JSON strings, not reinterpret their contents as JSON arrays/objects.
issues.evidence: Fresh native-vs-forced-fallback DuckDB probe: native fhirpath_json(resource, "'['") returned malformed JSON "[[]" and native fhirpath_json(resource, "'[1]'") returned [[1]], while forced Python fallback returned ["["] and ["[1]"] respectively. The native fhirpath() scalar correctly returned the string, so the bug is native JSON materialization only.
issues.resolution: Native fhirpath_json uses an internal owned-JSON marker instead of first-character raw JSON inference; rebuilt/copied bundled extension.
